name: Visual Reference Research
purpose: Collect and organize visual moodboards, palette references, and layout inspirations.
inputs: Product brief with audience, brand adjectives, and accessibility constraints
Existing palette, typography, spacing, and radius tokens
outputs: Sourced moodboard and clustered visual directions
Measured token draft with contrast and focus evidence
One recommendation, exclusions log, and implementation handoff
stop_conditions: One sourced direction, measured tokens, contrast evidence, and an exclusions log are complete
